migration.note: Test11 keeps Test10's performance rebase and adds one focused overlay. Detail expansion is globally selectable (manual, auto tags, auto tags+recommendations). Playback defaults to strict HTTP-only no-sniff using detail/player/script/API requests plus escaped/percent/Base64/P.A.C.K.E.R static decoding, direct M3U8/MP4 handoff and bounded media cache. Browser sniffing is disabled unless the user explicitly enables compatibility fallback.
